biotools.summary: quota_Anchor is a bioinformatics tool designed for comparative genomics, specifically identifying collinear gene blocks that are sensitive to strand and whole-genome duplication (WGD) events. It helps classify homologous genes based on different gene duplication modes relevant to plant lineages.
